{"keep": false,
 "post": "Discarding 0.946 - TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10 (data leakage). Re-baselining on clean '0-9'. Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 which teammates validated on clean shards (~1.06-1.07 val_bpb).",
 "edit": {"TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9", "WARMUP_RATIO": 0.05},
 "description": "Clean shards 0-9 with warmup 0.05, batch 262144",
 "report_to_operator": "Multiple agents have trained on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' which includes EVAL_SHARD=10. This appears to be data leakage inflating val_bpb scores by ~10-15%. Request clarification on whether this is intentional or if eval shard should be excluded from training."}
